children: WhiteHawk Minerals launched an SEC-effective offering of up to 100,000 shares of Series F Redeemable Preferred Stock at up to $1,000 per share, carrying a 7.5% annual cumulative dividend on a $1,000 stated value. The company engaged Preferred Capital Securities as dealer manager on a best-efforts basis, with compensation of up to a 2.5% dealer manager fee and up to a 5.5% selling commission, subject to reductions. WhiteHawk also executed a services agreement with Preferred Shareholder Services to support investor communications and administration, and adopted a form subscription agreement for investor purchases. The moves aim to streamline distribution and operations as the company raises capital through its Series F offering.
